concept: Encontrar. Coordinar. Saber a quién acudir.

navigation.mobile: Bottom navigation bar + top header with notification drawer

features: Authentication (Google Login + email/password with role selection: student, monitor, professor)
Dashboard with quick stats, recent questions, upcoming tutoring sessions, and AI advisor widget
Subject catalog with curriculum, resources, monitors list, and professor directory
Q&A Forum (Dudas) with tagging, filtering, upvoting, file attachments, and verified answers
Tutoring (Asesorías) booking system with calendar availability, online/in-person mode, and 'Mis Asesorías' manager
Realtime Chat (Chat) with peer-to-peer and group study rooms with file sharing
AI Assistant (Asistente IA) powered by GPT 5.4 Mini with Emergent LLM key for instant academic guidance
Global search bar with instant autocomplete across questions, subjects, tutors, and files
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete React application with .js files (JSX).
Use Tailwind CSS for styling with generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) and clean cards with 1px subtle borders.

Implement fully functional mock backend states or local API storage with robust localStorage fallback so all CRUD operations (questions, bookings, chat messages, file uploads, AI answers) work smoothly.
Ensure every interactive and key informational element has a data-testid attribute.
Maintain responsive layout with a persistent desktop sidebar and mobile bottom navigation.
Add toast notifications via sonner for all key user actions.
universal_guidelines: No universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
Do not center-align the app container.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for core navigation icons.
Ensure all text meets WCAG contrast requirements with explicit hover states.
Keep headers solid or use glassmorphism with backdrop blur and non-transparent background.
